title: thymus serpyllum f. austriacus
intro: Thymus serpyllum f. austriacus, commonly known as Austrian thyme, is a subspecies of the Thymus serpyllum plant, which belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This perennial herb is valued for its medicinal properties, health benefits, and therapeutic applications. The health benefits of Austrian thyme include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and calm the digestive system, alleviate respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Austrian thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties.
